What Workout Split Is Right for You?

The number of days you can really train decides most of it. Pick your schedule to see the best structures and a sample week.

Days a weekUsually best
2 daysFull body A/B2-day split →
3 daysFull body, or upper/lower/full body3-day split →
4 daysUpper / lower4-day split →
5 daysPPL + upper/lower hybrid, or body-part5-day split →
6 daysPush pull legs, or Arnold6-day split →
7 days6 lifting days + 1 rest7-day split →
Push Pull Legs →
Push, pull and leg days — 3 to 6 days
Upper Lower →
Upper and lower body — ideal for 4 days
Full Body →
Whole body each session — 2 to 3 days
Bro Split →
One muscle group per day — 5 days
Arnold Split →
Chest & back, shoulders & arms, legs — 6 days
